Q: VS Code: How do I hide parameters in functions in outline? A:

Pierre H. gave the answer :

  1. in the Settings tab (Ctrl+,)

  2. search "show variable"

  3. uncheck the option "Outline: Show Variables"

Q: Cypress unable to find a Quill editor in Angular table A:

Your XPath works because it searches all ancestors, but in Cypress .closest() only checks the nearest parent — and mat-label is usually not directly inside the <form> in Angular Material.

Use .parents() instead:

cy.contains('mat-label', label)
  .parents('form')
  .find('.ql-editor')
  .should('be.visible')
  .type(text);

Alternatively, scoping to mat-form-field is often more reliable:

cy.contains('mat-label', label)
  .closest('mat-form-field')
  .find('.ql-editor')
  .type(text);

This matches what your XPath is doing and works with Angular Material’s DOM structure.

Q: How do I get the unix timestamp in TwinCAT3? A:

Thanks for the example and the core idea, but there is need for few corrections:

1. FB_GetTimeZoneInformation bExecute is trigger based - so basically in your example it will be called only once; You can call the block each cycle without IF by applying the same if condition directly to bExecute.

2. Be careful with this block, as it is processed multiple cycles - this means You can use tzInfo output only when bBusy output is not active, otherwise, while the block is busy, it gives you false information to the tzInfo, thus leading to possible incorrect timestamps;

Q: Insert result from one insert query into another insert A:

You just need to wrap the first insert in a with clause. If you know all values in advance, you don't even need returning:

with ins as (
    insert into table1 (userid, email)
    values(12,'example@gmail.com') 
)
insert into table2 (userid, name, address)
values(12, 'Joe', '123 test Dr')

On the other hand, if userid is an autogenerated value, then you can return it from the CTE, and use it in the other insert as follows:

with ins as (
    insert into table1 (email)
    values('example@gmail.com') 
    returning userid
)
insert into table2 (userid, name, address)
select userid, 'joe', '123 test Dr'
from ins

Side note: use single quotes for literal strings. Double quotes are used for identifiers (column names, table names, and so on).

Q: How to mount a ebs_block_device using Terraform? A:

I have best option.

Use AWS provided command and identify the device_name passed with volume attachment

ebsnvme-id $device -b

$device="/dev/nvme1n1" it will return its device_name mentioned in volume attachment /dev/sdd
